sections.label: Summary
sections.content: Software Engineer with hands-on experience building production-grade AI-powered enterprise products. Worked on Orky.io, a production RAG-based enterprise chatbot integrating with ServiceNow, contributing to the full RAG pipeline including document ingestion, embedding, vector search, and LLM response generation. Proficient in Python, JavaScript, full-stack development, and RAG architecture.

content.title: AI Engineer Intern
bullets: Designed and implemented production RAG pipelines for Orky.io, handling document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, and vector-based retrieval to power accurate LLM responses.
Integrated LLM APIs (Python) into the chatbot backend, managing context window handling, rate limiting, and structured output generation for enterprise use cases.
Built and configured knowledge base connectors for ServiceNow and Freshworks, enabling employees to query internal tickets and documentation in natural language.
Managed code via Git and GitHub with feature branches, pull requests, and collaborative code reviews in an Agile sprint cadence.

Built end-to-end RAG pipelines — document ingestion & chunking, embedding generation, vector search, and LLM response synthesis — connecting employees to organizational knowledge via natural language.
Integrated Python LLM APIs with robust context-window management, retry logic, and structured JSON output formatting for enterprise reliability.
Developed custom knowledge base connectors for ServiceNow to pull tickets and articles directly into vector search index.
Deployed the system in production and iterated based on latency, chunk relevance scores, and employee feedback in an Agile team.

content.name: HireMe AI — Conversational Resume Portfolio (RAG-Powered)
bullets: Architected and deployed a full-stack conversational AI portfolio allowing recruiters to interview Animesh in real time with zero hallucination.
Built a 3-step RAG pipeline: query classification with dynamic temperature tuning (0.1 for technical, 0.3 for experience, 0.6 for general), keyword-based top chunk retrieval, and prompt augmentation.
Implemented real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming with token-by-token response generation and client-side sliding window conversation history.
Designed a responsive Claude-inspired dark mode UI with dynamic viewport height (100dvh) support for seamless mobile experiences.

content.name: Esports Strategy Platform
bullets: Designing an interactive strategy-planning platform for esports teams, filling the gap left by the absence of purpose-built tactics tools for competitive gaming.

Architecting interactive game maps (Leaflet.js, L.CRS.Simple) with POI markers, loot-tier overlays, and layer toggles, alongside a PostgreSQL/Node.js backend and a roadmap for real-time collaboration.

content.name: Blinkit Inventory Analytics
bullets: Cleaned and analyzed a retail sales dataset (10,000+ rows) using Excel and Python, uncovering seasonal demand trends across 5+ high-impact SKU categories.
Built an interactive Power BI dashboard tracking KPIs: stockout rates, category-wise revenue, and weekly sales trends.
